_note: A-1 requires ValuationSoftwareVendorName and ValuationSoftwareProductName (2100.0002, 2100.0033). They name the company and the product that produced the report. Set them before exporting; export is refused while either is empty. Never use a sample's values. Set 2026-10-04 at the owner's instruction (the earlier brand removed everywhere): vendor and product 'UAD 3.6 Form Filler' until the owner names the company. A-1 also requires ValuationSoftwareProductIdentifier and ValuationSoftwareProductVersionIdentifier (both R, both 'Does Not Display'); the identifier falls back to the product name and the version is set at release.
